Answer: F
Reason: The CT images demonstrate a large right pleural effusion with compressive atelectasis of the right lung, while the cardiac silhouette appears normal in size. In an elderly patient with increasing dyspnea and these specific findings (unilateral effusion without cardiomegaly), Scimitar syndrome (a congenital vascular anomaly involving anomalous pulmonary venous return) is a rare but distinct differential that fits the description in option F better than heart failure or pneumonia.
